record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — P2/conf100 `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` has no uniqueness refine and no `.min(1)` (only the client dialog checks for duplicates), and the handler's filter only compares against existing attendees, so an API call with `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]` inserts two Attendee rows for the same person and sends them two emails.

adjudication.rationale: The server-side input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` only validates email format (`guests: z.array(z.string().email())`) and does not enforce uniqueness or non-empty. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted ones, but it does not deduplicate within the `guests` input itself. Therefore an input like `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]` will produce `uniqueGuests` containing both entries and `createMany` will attempt to insert two attendee rows with the same email. If inserted, the later email-sending path builds `attendeesList` from DB attendees and iterates `calendarEvent.attendees`, which would send duplicate emails for duplicated attendee records.
